Uh, I think the second person who's had beena big influence with me, is my friend Satyajit

Satyajit and I went to school together.

Uh, I mean, I wasn't doing anything wrong.

Rajasthan and Maharashtra, and in both therestates the ratio has gone up by fifty to sixty

I mean, it’s sad.
What I’m saying is sad, you know, it’slike black humor.

but in India we have to have a law, becauseas Indians we’ve, in the past, seen that

Dowry Issues
Aamir: Contextualize it for people who livehere in the U.S. I would imagine about 90

I said: “Why are we – with what drivingemotion are we doing this show?

I’m not excluded in that we need to lookinward, you know, at ourselves.

India is ready for change.

That we have issues that we have problemsbut we want to leave them behind, we want

I mean...
Aamir: We have a lot of fights.
Zainab: And I mean are there subjects whereyou say “we’re not going to touch that”?

Sure equality is an issue in a lot of societies,but I think in India, because of the way the

What we doing is it right, is it, are we comfortablewith it, you know, so.

We do it with a lot of love, so that people...

What is, what is it to be male?

speech.

We are all behind you, thank you so much.
Thank you, thank you, thank you!
